_doc: Each entry: { file: relative path from repo root, anchor: a substring of the exempted line (the ONLY per-line key — position keys are refused by validate_allowlist), or lines: "*" for the whole file, reason: short justification }. Use sparingly — first ask whether the file should be neutralized or carved out. Policy cap: > 20 exempted FILES means the linter (or the content) is wrong — fix the tool or the text, never grow the list. The cap counts files because that is the unit it was written in, when one entry meant one file; entries are now per-line, so the two numbers differ on purpose (15 files / 31 entries as of the anchor migration) and the entry count is not the cap. Rebuilt 2026-07-12 (road-to-opt-hygiene-and-debt Phase 1): 104 -> minimal set after heuristic upgrades + 25 content neutralizations + 2 carve-outs. Re-keyed to content anchors 2026-08-12: 8 of the 39 exempted lines were found to exempt nothing — three named blank or out-of-range lines, five named lines that produce no hit — and were dropped rather than carried forward; the gate now refuses both shapes.
